purpose: Teach: 中曽根/ドール/ジョーンズ/サード/ハリス/菅/内藤/ダニエル

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、中曽根政権時代の規制緩和を社員研修で取り上げろ
lines.en: During staff training, I want us to cover the deregulation period under Nakasone's administration and what it meant for our company.
lines.style: Clipped, businesslike opening. Authority without harshness. Each phrase lands with weight. Measured pace. This is an instruction, not a request.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。米国ドール社との青果取引を更新します
lines.en: Understood. I'll update our produce distribution agreement with the US Dole company.
lines.style: Respectful, attentive acknowledgment. Slightly formal register. Steady, professional delivery. Shows he's taking note and ready to act.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、英国の取引先ジョーンズ社との会合を設定しろ
lines.en: Set up a meeting with Jones Company, our UK partner.
lines.style: Direct command, but not unkind. Brisk tempo. No softening language. Assumes competence and compliance.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。サードパーティの監査を導入します
lines.en: Understood. We'll bring in third-party auditing to strengthen oversight.
lines.style: Professional confirmation. Slightly more proactive — not just accepting but suggesting next steps. Calm, capable tone.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、米国のハリス社との合弁を進めろ
lines.en: Move forward with the joint venture with Harris Corporation in the US.
lines.style: Firm but not harsh. Each word precise. The tone of someone accustomed to being followed. Steady eye contact in the voice.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新任の菅部長を歓迎します
lines.en: Understood. I'll make sure we properly welcome our new department head, Suga.
lines.style: Assured confirmation. A touch warmer than before — showing he understands this involves both operations and people. Still professional.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、技術顧問の内藤先生にご助言を仰げ
lines.en: Consult with Dr. Naito, our technical advisor, and get his recommendations.
lines.style: Clear instruction with respect embedded in it. The naming of Dr. Naito shows deference to his expertise. Measured, deliberate pacing.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。海外の主任ダニエル氏との連携を強化します
lines.en: I'll strengthen our coordination with Daniel, our overseas operations lead.
lines.style: Final confirmation, slightly firmer. Shows initiative and understanding of priorities. Professional close — completing the cycle of the exchange.
